title: 독립유공자예우에 관한 법률에 의한 가족관계등록 사무처리규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 독립유공자예우에 관한 법률에 의한 가족관계등록 사무처리규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Processing by the Head of a Si (Gu), Eup, or Myeon)
(1) Upon receiving an original copy of permission to create a family relations register, the head of the relevant Si (Gu), Eup, or Myeon shall promptly prepare the family relations register and, after recording the person's death, close that register.
(2) After preparing the family relations register, the head of the relevant Si (Gu), Eup, or Myeon shall issue one copy each of the family relations certificate and the basic certificate and send them to the Administrator of the National Veterans Affairs Agency.
